title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: the withdrawal fee amount the account bears in a replenishment transfer
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks for a monthly automatic transfer that puts back what overdraft protection took from the savings account in a statement cycle, together with the withdrawal fee amount the account bears for that cycle. It fixes that fee amount.

## Policy clause

1. The withdrawal fee amount the account bears for the cycle is the total of the amounts of every excess withdrawal fee entry of the cycle, less the total of the amounts of every excess withdrawal fee refund entry posted in the cycle, whatever its ground, taken as zero if negative.
2. Unlike the fee coverage used when a cycle's excess withdrawal charges are reconciled, a courtesy refund also reduces what the account bears.
3. Every excess withdrawal fee owed for the cycle has been charged before the monthly replenishment amount is computed.
4. Every excess withdrawal fee refund owed for the cycle has been posted before the monthly replenishment amount is computed.

Where either of the last two conditions does not yet hold, the monthly replenishment amount is not computed.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** Fee entries and refund entries, with their amounts, fee type, ground and statement cycle, are read from the savings account's transaction record.
- **Object correlation.** Only excess withdrawal fee entries and excess withdrawal fee refund entries of the cycle being put back are taken; a monthly maintenance fee or its refund plays no part.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical amounts; the USD 8.00 charge is illustrative, not a tier value)

| Entry in the cycle | Amount | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| excess withdrawal fee entry | USD 8.00 | added |
| excess withdrawal fee entry | USD 8.00 | added |
| excess withdrawal fee entry | USD 8.00 | added |
| excess withdrawal fee refund entry, bank error | USD 8.00 | subtracted |
| excess withdrawal fee refund entry, courtesy | USD 8.00 | subtracted |
| monthly maintenance fee entry | USD 6.00 | ignored |

USD 24.00 less USD 16.00 gives a withdrawal fee amount the account bears of USD 8.00. The courtesy refund is subtracted here, as clause 2 states.

## Floor at zero (hypothetical)

A cycle carries one excess withdrawal fee entry of USD 8.00 and refund entries of USD 16.00 posted in it. USD 8.00 less USD 16.00 is below zero, so the amount the account bears is taken as USD 0.00, never a negative figure.

## Points of judgement

**Wrong reading:** "Only a bank-error refund is subtracted." **Correct basis:** every excess withdrawal fee refund entry posted in the cycle is subtracted, whatever its ground.

**Wrong reading:** "Size the transfer on the entries as they stand at the start of the call." **Correct basis:** the amount is computed only after every excess withdrawal fee owed for the cycle has been charged and every excess withdrawal fee refund owed for the cycle has been posted.
